title: M78 real-client smoke: join, chunks, move, edit, container, disconnect
client_evidence_requirement: real vanilla 26.1.2 client or PrismLauncher-launched instance only

preconditions.world_prep: Use example.toml with .analysis/test-world. Before starting Solaris, prepare spawn so the player can stand at (0, 64, 0), target dirt is present at (0, 64, 1), air is clear at (0, 65, 1), and a chest is placed at (2, 64, 0) with air above it.

hotbar_block.prep: Put at least one minecraft:dirt stack in selected hotbar slot 0 before the break/place step.

simple_container.prep: Place an openable chest at (2, 64, 0) near spawn before starting the run.

steps.action: Connect to 127.0.0.1:25565 with a real vanilla 26.1.2 client.
steps.evidence: Client reaches play world without protocol/configuration disconnect.

steps.action: Wait until spawn chunks are visible and the player can look around without void-only terrain.
steps.evidence: Screenshot or structured note records visible terrain and no obvious chunk-hole desync.

steps.action: Walk at least five blocks from spawn and stop.
steps.evidence: Observation records no rubber-band loop or disconnect.

steps.action: In survival mode, select hotbar slot 0 containing minecraft:dirt, break the prepared dirt block at (0, 64, 1), then place minecraft:dirt back at (0, 64, 1).
steps.evidence: Observation records successful break and place, including whether block ack/resync matched the client view.

steps.action: Open and close the prepared minecraft:chest at (2, 64, 0).
steps.evidence: Observation records successful container open and close for the chest at (2, 64, 0).

steps.action: Disconnect cleanly from the multiplayer menu.
steps.evidence: Client and server logs show clean disconnect or exact failure.
